declarations.description:
A quiz groups multiple question elements into one exercise that is
submitted, graded and reset as a whole.

The tasks must be assigned to the default slot.

In WebWriter 2, use the quiz's question buttons to insert questions. The
package includes one-question snippets for each built-in type with question
titles and points hidden.

In edit mode, "Add Feedback" inserts a block that can be edited and
formatted in the question. Choice and Order group it with "Add Option" in
both layouts. The last question shares that row with "Add Question" on the
right. Learners see the feedback block after a valid submission, including
for open-ended and ungraded questions. "Show detailed feedback" controls
answer-specific feedback and solution reveal.
declarations.name: WebwriterQuiz

members.name: type
members.description:
The kind of input field learners answer in.

- `long-text`: A multi-line text area.
- `text`: A single-line text field.
- `number`: A number field.
- `date`: A date picker.
- `time`: A time picker.
- `datetime-local`: A combined date and time picker.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The placeholder shown while the field is empty.

members.name: freeText
members.description: Whether any non-empty answer counts as correct, without comparing it to the solution.

members.name: ignoreCase
members.description: Whether the answer is compared to the solution case-insensitively.

members.name: correctMessage
members.description: The feedback shown after submitting if the answer is correct.

members.name: wrongMessage
members.description: The feedback shown after submitting if the answer is wrong.

members.name: solution
members.description: The value counting as correct. It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

members.name: actions
members.description: Only questions inside a quiz can be moved or deleted from the drawer.
members.default: { moveQuestionUp: { label: (widget: { msg: MsgFn }) => widget.msg("Move question up") }, moveQuestionDown: { label: (widget: { msg: MsgFn }) => widget.msg("Move question down") }, deleteQuestion: { label: (widget: { msg: MsgFn }) => widget.msg("Delete question"), intent: "danger" as const }, }

members.name: points
members.description: The maximum score for this question.

members.name: feedback
members.deprecated: Author a webwriter-quiz-feedback child in the feedback slot.

members.name: slotObserver
members.default: new MutationObserver(records => { if (records.some(record => record.target === this || record.target.parentNode === this)) this.requestUpdate(); })

members.name: editing
members.description: True in edit mode. The widget renders again when the mode changes.

members.name: declarationsWithout
members.description: The static declarations of this class as the editor reads them, without the entries that do not apply at the moment.
